name: Environmental Sensors (openSenseMap + Sensor.Community)
description: Citizen science environmental sensor stations showing temperature, humidity, PM2.5, PM10, UV, noise, and more

opensensemap.purpose: Environmental sensor stations (temperature, humidity, PM2.5, PM10, pressure, UV, noise)
opensensemap.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates, exposure filter (outdoor/indoor), date
opensensemap.dataReceived: Sensor boxes with coordinates, last measurement, exposure, model, sensors with latest values

sensor-community.purpose: Citizen-driven air quality and environmental sensors (merged with openSenseMap, deduplicated)
sensor-community.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates, hardware sensor type
sensor-community.dataReceived: Sensor entries with coordinates, timestamp, sensor type, measurement values
